content.title: Animated City Carousel | Identity-Locked Outfit and Location Rotation
content.summary: An adult animated sound engineer turns through four city outfits and returns to the same rainy crossing. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult original identity retains face, hair, eye color, accessory and body proportions across all chapters. + A single repeated full-turn carrier precedes every location and wardrobe change. + Each chapter changes declared environment, light and outfit together while holding screen registration. + A complete front-facing verification pose follows every transition before another change begins. + The terminal chapter returns to the opening environment and wardrobe under one exact original title.
quick_start.recommended_input: Lock one clearly adult original animated sound engineer with a violet bob, gold eyes, a small square ear cuff and consistent proportions at a rainy cobalt night crossing. Repeat the same turn carrier through an amber market with rust streetwear, a green subway platform with a navy utility coat and a pale snowy lane with a charcoal parka. The final turn returns to the rainy cobalt crossing and original dark jacket beneath the exact title "SAME SIGNAL / NEW CITY".
required_anchors: One clearly adult original identity retains face, hair, eye color, accessory and body proportions across all chapters.
A single repeated full-turn carrier precedes every location and wardrobe change.
A complete front-facing verification pose follows every transition before another change begins.
The terminal chapter returns to the opening environment and wardrobe under one exact original title.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An adult animated sound engineer turns through four city outfits and returns to the same rainy crossing. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 锁定同一成年动画人物的粉色发型、绿眼和身体比例，让城市、昼夜与服装在多个章节切换；每次变换后先证明完整人物，终局回到与开场呼应的夜间街口。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult original identity retains face, hair, eye color, accessory and body proportions across all chapters.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult original identity retains face, hair, eye color, accessory and body proportions across all chapters."

invariants.rule: A single repeated full-turn carrier precedes every location and wardrobe change.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "A single repeated full-turn carrier precedes every location and wardrobe change."

invariants.rule: Each chapter changes declared environment, light and outfit together while holding screen registration.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Each chapter changes declared environment, light and outfit together while holding screen registration."

invariants.rule: A complete front-facing verification pose follows every transition before another change begins.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "A complete front-facing verification pose follows every transition before another change begins."

invariants.rule: The terminal chapter returns to the opening environment and wardrobe under one exact original title.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal chapter returns to the opening environment and wardrobe under one exact original title."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
